title: A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines
summary: David H. Ackley, Geoffrey E. Hinton, and Terrence J. Sejnowski published 'A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines' in Cognitive Science in January 1985. The paper describes a parallel search method based on statistical mechanics and a learning rule for modifying connection strengths so that task-domain knowledge can be represented in the network.
significance: A documented 1985 machine-learning publication milestone for Boltzmann machines, represented strictly as a publication event.
